{{Short description|French mathematician (1910–1990)}}
'''Claude Chabauty''' (May 4, 1910, in [[Oran]] – June 2, 1990, in Dieulefit) was a French [[mathematician]].

== Career ==

He was admitted in 1929 to the [[École normale supérieure (Paris)|École normale supérieure]] in Paris.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.archicubes.ens.fr/lannuaire#annuaire_chercher?identite=Chabauty |title=L'annuaire - a-Ulm |website=Association des anciens élèves, élèves et amis de l’École normale supérieure |access-date=April 14, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150520151458/http://www.archicubes.ens.fr/lannuaire#annuaire_chercher?identite=Chabauty |archive-date=May 20, 2015 |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 1938 he obtained his doctorate with a thesis on [[number theory]] and [[algebraic geometry]]. Subsequently he was a professor in Strasbourg.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.numbertheory.org/obituaries/OTHERS/chabauty/chabauty2.html | title=Claude Chabauty|website=Number Theory Web|access-date=April 14, 2019}}</ref> From 1954 on, and for 22 years, he was the director of the department of pure mathematics at the [[Université Grenoble Alpes|University of Grenoble]].<ref name=AIF/>

== Mathematical work ==

He worked on [[Diophantine approximation]] and [[geometry of numbers]], where he used both classical and [[p-adic number|p-adic]] analytic methods.<ref name=AIF>[http://www.numbertheory.org/obituaries/OTHERS/chabauty/ special issue] of [[Annales de l'Institut Fourier]] (vol. XXIX, Fasc. 1), March 1979, for Chabauty's retirement</ref> He introduced the [[Chabauty topology]] to generalise [[Mahler's compactness theorem]] from Euclidean lattices to more general [[discrete subgroup]]s.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Chabauty |first1=Claude |date=1950 |title=Limite d'ensembles et géométrie des nombres |journal=Bulletin de la Société Mathématique de France |volume=78 |pages=143–151 |doi=10.24033/bsmf.1412 |s2cid=125105731 |url=https://www.numdam.org/item?id=BSMF_1950__78__143_0}}</ref>

His 1938 doctoral thesis,<ref>{{cite journal|author=Chabauty, Claude|title=Sur les équations diophantiennes liées aux unités d'un corps de nombres algébriques fini|journal=Annali di Matematica Pura ed Applicata|volume=17|issue=1|year=1938|pages=127–168|doi=10.1007/BF02410698 |s2cid=123856131 |url=https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/BF02410698.pdf}}</ref> developing ideas of [[Thoralf Skolem|Skolem]],<ref name="Skolem1935">{{cite journal|last1=Skolem|first1=Th.|title=Einige Sätze über 𝔭-adische Potenzreihen mit Anwendung auf gewisse exponentielle Gleichungen|journal=Mathematische Annalen|volume=111|issue=1|year=1935|pages=399–424|issn=0025-5831|doi=10.1007/BF01472228|s2cid=121512248 }}</ref> is important in algebraic geometry. According to [[André Weil]]:
{{blockquote|In his beautiful thesis, Chabauty ..., following ideas of Skolem ..., has shown how the method of ''p''-adic completion, with respect to a more or less arbitrary prime ''p'', can yield deep results about varieties over an algebraic number-field; there, as already in Skolem's work, the problem concerns the intersection of an algebraic variety and of a multiplicative group; by ''p''-adic completion, the latter becomes an algebroid variety defined by linear differential equations.<ref>{{cite book|author=Weil, André|chapter=Number-theory and algebraic geometry|title=Proc. Intern. Math. Congress, Cambridge, Mass.|volume=2|pages=90–100|year=1950}} (quote from p. 94)</ref>}}
